highlights.title_zh: braindecode 一夜连修 6 个 PR：NaN 污染、参数误传与 iEEG 变长通道批次
highlights.title_en: braindecode Landed Six Fix PRs Overnight: NaN Contamination, Misrouted Params, Variable-Channel Batches
highlights.brief: braindecode 在 10 月 24 日夜到 25 日凌晨连合并 **6 个修复 PR**，其中两个属「静默污染数据」类型：#1481 修指数滑动标准化/去均值**把一个 NaN 扩散到整通道**（坏段被置 NaN 后整段特征全废），#1488 让 EpiNT 在丢弃末段样本前先对**整个窗口**做 z-score（否则统计量只覆盖部分窗口）。其余为：#1484 多目标数据集固定长度窗口返回 pandas Series、#1485 硬编码 n_times/sfreq 默认值误拒一致几何、#1491 EEGPrep wrapper 签名保持已保存流水线兼容，以及 #1487 为 iEEG 基础模型支持**通道数可变批次**（ch_mask）——这对电极密度不一的颅内数据是刚需。用这些模型做在线或跨数据集实验的团队建议逐条核对受影响路径。

highlights.title_zh: MNE-Python 修 regress_artifact：picks_artifact 被当成 exclude 传入
highlights.title_en: MNE-Python Fixes regress_artifact: picks_artifact Was Landed in exclude
highlights.brief: MNE-Python 合并 #14457，修掉一个典型的位置传参事故：在「传入已计算好 betas」的代码路径里，`picks_artifact` 被按位置传给函数，实际落到了 **`exclude`** 参数上——结果伪迹回归排除的是错误的通道集合，而不是指定的伪迹通道。这类 bug 不报错，只有当你去检查残差、或下游解码结果异常时才会察觉，因此隐蔽性很高。对用 `regress_artifact` 做眼电/肌电回归、尤其是复用预计算 betas 的流水线，建议升级后重跑关键对比，并显式检查被排除通道列表是否符合预期。

highlights.title_zh: MOABB 让 get_data 在通道/采样率不一致时返回嵌套试次
highlights.title_en: MOABB Lets get_data Return Nested Trials When Recordings Differ in Channels or Rate
highlights.brief: MOABB 合并 #1327：当不同记录的**通道集合或采样率不一致**时，`get_data` 改为返回**嵌套（nested）试次**结构。这不是小改动——真实公开数据集大量混用不同蒙太奇与采样率，此前这类数据集在跨被试/跨会话取数时会直接失败，或更糟：被静默拼接到错误的对齐假设上。改为嵌套返回后，取数不再替用户做「假装一致」的决定，而是把差异显式暴露出来，由分析者决定如何重参考或重采样。对做异构数据集批量实验（尤其是想纳入更多公开数据）的团队，这是能否把数据取进来的一步；升级后请检查既有流程对返回结构的假设。

items.title_zh: braindecode 一夜连修 6 个 PR：NaN 污染、参数误传与 iEEG 变长通道批次
items.title_en: braindecode Landed Six Fix PRs Overnight: NaN Contamination, Misrouted Params, Variable-Channel Batches
bullets_zh: #1481 修「指数滑动标准化/去均值把一个 NaN 扩散到整通道」，#1484 修多目标数据集固定长度窗口返回 pandas Series 的问题，#1485 修硬编码 n_times/sfreq 默认值误拒一致几何。
#1488 让 EpiNT 在丢弃末段样本前先对**整个窗口**做 z-score；#1491 修 EEGPrep wrapper 签名以保持已保存流水线兼容。
#1487 为 iEEG 基础模型支持**通道数可变**的批次（ch_mask），对颅内多电极密度的真实数据很关键。
bullets_en: #1481 stops exponential moving standardize/demean spreading one NaN to a whole channel, #1484 fixes fixed-length windows of a multi-target dataset returning a pandas Series, and #1485 fixes hard-coded n_times/sfreq defaults rejecting consistent geometries.
#1488 makes EpiNT z-score the whole window before dropping trailing samples, and #1491 fixes EEGPrep wrapper signatures to keep saved pipelines compatible.
#1487 supports batches with varying channel counts (ch_mask) for iEEG foundation models, which matters for real multi-density electrode data.
items.brief: braindecode 在 10 月 24 日夜到 25 日凌晨连合并 **6 个修复 PR**，其中两个属「静默污染数据」类型：#1481 修指数滑动标准化/去均值**把一个 NaN 扩散到整通道**（坏段被置 NaN 后整段特征全废），#1488 让 EpiNT 在丢弃末段样本前先对**整个窗口**做 z-score（否则统计量只覆盖部分窗口）。其余为：#1484 多目标数据集固定长度窗口返回 pandas Series、#1485 硬编码 n_times/sfreq 默认值误拒一致几何、#1491 EEGPrep wrapper 签名保持已保存流水线兼容，以及 #1487 为 iEEG 基础模型支持**通道数可变批次**（ch_mask）——这对电极密度不一的颅内数据是刚需。用这些模型做在线或跨数据集实验的团队建议逐条核对受影响路径。
items.brief_en: braindecode merged six fix PRs overnight into Oct 25, two of them silent data corruption: #1481 stops exponential moving standardize/demean spreading one NaN across a whole channel, and #1488 makes EpiNT z-score the entire window before dropping trailing samples. Also #1484, #1485, #1491 (pipeline compatibility) and #1487 (variable channel counts for iEEG models).

items.title_zh: MNE-Python 修 regress_artifact：picks_artifact 被当成 exclude 传入
items.title_en: MNE-Python Fixes regress_artifact: picks_artifact Was Landed in exclude
bullets_zh: #14457：在传入已算好的 betas 的代码路径里，`picks_artifact` 按位置传参，实际落到了 **`exclude`** 变量上——伪迹回归会因此排除错误的通道。
这类参数错位不会报错，只会让「已回归掉的伪迹」与预期不符，且往往在检查残差或下游解码时才暴露。
对用 regress_artifact 做眼电/肌电回归的团队，建议升级后重跑关键对比并检查被排除的通道列表。
bullets_en: #14457: on the code path that accepts precomputed betas, picks_artifact was passed positionally and actually landed in the exclude variable, so artefact regression excluded the wrong channels.
Such argument slips raise no error; they only make regressed results differ from expectations, usually surfacing later in residual checks or downstream decoding.
Teams using regress_artifact for EOG/EMG regression should re-run key comparisons and inspect the excluded channel list after upgrading.
items.brief: MNE-Python 合并 #14457，修掉一个典型的位置传参事故：在「传入已计算好 betas」的代码路径里，`picks_artifact` 被按位置传给函数，实际落到了 **`exclude`** 参数上——结果伪迹回归排除的是错误的通道集合，而不是指定的伪迹通道。这类 bug 不报错，只有当你去检查残差、或下游解码结果异常时才会察觉，因此隐蔽性很高。对用 `regress_artifact` 做眼电/肌电回归、尤其是复用预计算 betas 的流水线，建议升级后重跑关键对比，并显式检查被排除通道列表是否符合预期。
items.brief_en: MNE-Python merged #14457 fixing a positional-argument slip: on the path accepting precomputed betas, picks_artifact landed in the exclude parameter, so artefact regression excluded the wrong channels. It raises no error and only shows up in residuals or downstream decoding, so pipelines reusing precomputed betas should re-run key comparisons and inspect the excluded channel list.
items.raw_excerpt: PR #14457: "BUG: Fix picks_artifact passed as exclude in regress_artifact — There seems to have been a slipup in the regression code when you passed in already computed betas. The issue was that `picks_artifact` was passed positionally and actually ended up in the `exclude` variable." Merged 2026-10-25T07:17Z.
items.why_valuable: 位置传参把伪迹通道塞进 exclude，回归排除错通道且不报错，需重跑核对。

items.title_zh: MOABB 让 get_data 在通道/采样率不一致时返回嵌套试次
items.title_en: MOABB Lets get_data Return Nested Trials When Recordings Differ in Channels or Rate
bullets_zh: #1327：当不同记录的**通道集合或采样率不一致**时，`get_data` 改为返回嵌套（nested）试次结构，而不是强行拼接或报错。
真实公开数据集常混用不同蒙太奇或采样率；此前这类数据集在跨被试/跨会话取数时会失败或被静默错误对齐。
对做异构数据集批量实验的团队，这意味着可以先把数据取进来，再自行决定如何对齐/重采样。
bullets_en: #1327 makes get_data return nested trials when recordings differ in channel set or sampling rate, instead of forcing a concatenation or failing.
Real public datasets often mix montages or rates; such datasets previously failed on cross-subject/cross-session retrieval or were silently misaligned.
For teams running batch experiments over heterogeneous datasets, this lets data be loaded first and aligned or resampled explicitly afterwards.
items.brief: MOABB 合并 #1327：当不同记录的**通道集合或采样率不一致**时，`get_data` 改为返回**嵌套（nested）试次**结构。这不是小改动——真实公开数据集大量混用不同蒙太奇与采样率，此前这类数据集在跨被试/跨会话取数时会直接失败，或更糟：被静默拼接到错误的对齐假设上。改为嵌套返回后，取数不再替用户做「假装一致」的决定，而是把差异显式暴露出来，由分析者决定如何重参考或重采样。对做异构数据集批量实验（尤其是想纳入更多公开数据）的团队，这是能否把数据取进来的一步；升级后请检查既有流程对返回结构的假设。
items.brief_en: MOABB merged #1327 so get_data returns nested trials when recordings differ in channel set or sampling rate. Public datasets frequently mix montages and rates; previously such data failed on retrieval or was silently concatenated under a wrong alignment assumption. Nested returns surface the difference for the analyst to resolve, so existing pipelines should re-check structural assumptions.
items.raw_excerpt: PR #1327 merged 2026-10-24T20:15Z: "Let get_data return nested trials when recordings differ in channels or sample rate[s]". Same window: "Pass every filter band to get_data in the evaluations (#1291)" 16:34Z and "Add dataset and device columns to the paradigm metadata (leave-one-device-out …)" (PR #1328, 2026-10-25T18:39Z).
items.why_valuable: 异构数据集取数不再失败或静默错对齐，差异被显式暴露给分析者。

items.title_en: pyPTE 1.15.0 Adds an Opt-in centre_on_null to surrogate_test
bullets_zh: 版本 1.15.0 新增 `centre_on_null`（opt-in）：替代检验时把观测值相对**零分布中心**做校正，而不是直接与零分布比较。
同批提交还有教程修订，明确「epochs 用于条件比较，并不能提升单条记录的证据强度」——这类方法学提醒比功能更值得看。
pyPTE 是相位转移熵（Phase Transfer Entropy）的 Python 实现，常用于 EEG 有效连接分析。
bullets_en: Version 1.15.0 adds an opt-in centre_on_null: surrogate testing can centre the observed value on the null distribution instead of comparing raw.
The same batch revises the tutorial to state that epochs compare conditions and do not strengthen evidence about a single recording — a methodological caution worth more than the feature.
pyPTE implements phase transfer entropy, widely used for effective connectivity in EEG.
items.brief: pyPTE（相位转移熵的 Python 实现，常用于 EEG 有效连接分析）发布 1.15.0，并合并 #120：为 `surrogate_test` 增加可选的 **`centre_on_null`**——替代检验时可把观测值相对零分布中心做校正，而不是拿原始值与零分布直接比较。对相位转移熵这类对偏置敏感的方法，是否中心化会影响显著性判断。同批提交还修订了教程，明确写下一条方法学提醒：**epochs 用于条件之间的比较，并不能提升对单条记录的证据强度**。这句话对很多「多切几个 epoch 让结果更显著」的做法是直接否定，建议做连接分析的团队升级时一并阅读教程改动。
items.brief_en: pyPTE (phase transfer entropy in Python, common for EEG effective connectivity) released 1.15.0 with #120 adding an opt-in centre_on_null to surrogate_test, so observed values can be centred on the null distribution rather than compared raw — which changes significance calls. The tutorial revision also states that epochs compare conditions and do not strengthen single-recording evidence.
items.raw_excerpt: Commits 2026-10-25: "1.15.0" 11:39Z; "feat(stats): opt-in centre_on_null for surrogate_test (#111) (#120)" 11:35Z; "docs(tutorial): epochs compare conditions, they do not beat one record" 11:18Z; "1.14.3" 10-24T21:50Z.
items.why_valuable: 替代检验是否中心化会改变显著性判断，且教程明确否定「多切 epoch 增强证据」。

items.title_zh: aeon-neuro 修 BIDS 往返中 BioSemi Status 通道单位被改成伏特
items.title_en: aeon-neuro Preserves Dimensionless Status Units Through BIDS Round-Trips
bullets_zh: #232：一个未改动的 BioSemi Status 通道，经 MNE-BIDS 写入再读回后会从**无量纲**变成**伏特**，尽管数值本身没变。
单位错误会让下游按物理量处理触发通道（例如把它当电压过滤或统计），或让格式校验失败。
对做 BIDS 导出/导入往返的团队，建议升级后对比一次 Status 通道的 units 与数值。
bullets_en: #232: an unchanged BioSemi Status channel can turn from dimensionless into volts after an MNE-BIDS write-and-read-back, even though its numeric values are preserved.
A wrong unit makes downstream code treat a trigger channel as a physical signal (filtering or statistics) or breaks format validation.
Teams doing BIDS export/import round-trips should compare the Status channel's units and values after upgrading.
items.brief: aeon-neuro 合并 #232：一个**未改动**的 BioSemi Status 通道，在经 MNE-BIDS 写入并读回后会从「无量纲」变成「伏特」——数值没变，单位变了。这类问题在 BIDS 往返里很隐蔽：Status/Trigger 通道本是事件编码，本不该被当成物理量，但单位一旦变成伏特，下游滤波、阈值判断或格式校验就可能把它当信号处理，甚至写出不符合 BIDS 规范的文件。对做数据共享、BIDS 导出的实验室，建议升级后对同一份数据做一次 write→read→比对（units 与数值都看），并检查触发通道是否被误纳入生理信号集合。
items.brief_en: aeon-neuro merged #232: an unchanged BioSemi Status channel becomes volts after an MNE-BIDS write-and-read-back though its numbers are intact. Trigger channels should stay dimensionless; a wrong unit invites downstream filtering or validation errors and possibly non-compliant BIDS files. Labs sharing data should run a write-read-compare check on units and values.
items.raw_excerpt: PR #232: "[BUG] Preserve dimensionless Status units in BIDS conversion — An unchanged BioSemi Status channel can change from dimensionless to volts on MNE-BIDS read-back even though its numeric values are preserved." Merged 2026-10-25T14:16Z.
items.why_valuable: Status 通道单位被改成伏特，会让触发码被当生理信号处理或校验失败。

items.title_zh: eeg-step：发布到 PyPI 的单试次 EEG 流水线
items.title_en: eeg-step: A Single-Trial EEG Pipeline Published on PyPI
bullets_zh: 定位单试次（single-trial）EEG 分析流水线，已发布到 PyPI，带 ReadTheDocs 文档、CI 与覆盖率徽章。
单试次分析关注「逐个试次估计」而非条件平均，常用于解码、单试次 ERP 与在线场景；这类流程此前多以脚本形式散落。
仓库规模不大（约 200 KB），适合作为规范化模板；采用前应确认其对预处理步骤与统计模型的具体约定。
bullets_en: A single-trial EEG pipeline published to PyPI with ReadTheDocs documentation, CI and coverage badges.
Single-trial analysis estimates per trial rather than condition averages, common in decoding, single-trial ERP and online settings, and previously scattered as scripts.
The repository is small (~200 KB) and works well as a normalized template; check its preprocessing and statistical conventions before adopting.
items.brief: alexenge/eeg-step 在 10 月 25 日凌晨（UTC 10-24T16:13）有更新，定位是**单试次 EEG 流水线**并已发布到 PyPI：有 ReadTheDocs 文档、GitHub Actions 与 codecov 覆盖率、pyproject 打包，结构规范（src/、docs/、tests）。单试次分析关注「逐个试次估计」而不是条件平均，广泛用于解码、单试次 ERP 与在线实验；这类流程过去多以零散脚本存在，把它做成可安装包对复现与方法复用有实际意义。仓库不大，适合当模板；采用前建议先读其对预处理顺序、基线校正与统计模型的约定，确认与自己的分析口径一致。
items.brief_en: alexenge/eeg-step, updated in the early hours of Oct 25 UTC (10-24T16:13), is a single-trial EEG pipeline published to PyPI with ReadTheDocs, CI, coverage and a proper src/ layout. Single-trial analysis estimates per trial rather than condition averages, common in decoding and online work; packaging it makes the workflow reusable. Read its preprocessing and statistical conventions before adopting.
items.raw_excerpt: Repo: alexenge/eeg-step — "Single-trial EEG pipeline"; README shows PyPI, Python, License (MIT), Docs (readthedocs), Workflow and Coverage (codecov) badges. Contents include .readthedocs.yaml, pyproject.toml, docs, src. Latest push 2026-10-24T16:13Z.
items.why_valuable: 把单试次分析从零散脚本变成可安装包，便于复现与方法复用。

items.title_zh: MNE-CPP 修绘图：ImageSc 坐标用数据单位、ColorMap 覆盖完整映射
items.title_en: MNE-CPP Plotting Fixes: ImageSc in Data Units, ColorMap Spanning the Full Map
bullets_zh: FEAT：ImageSc 的坐标轴改用**数据单位**，固定颜色范围并给出可读刻度；FIX：`ColorMap::valueToColor(v, "RedBlue")` 现在覆盖完整红蓝映射（此前只用到一部分）。
配套还有五个示例的插图重绘、niceticks.h 的 clang-format 与 API 页面重生成——属于「图表可信度」类改进。
对用 MNE-CPP 生成报告图或核对结果的团队，颜色映射截断会让人误读数值分布。
bullets_en: FEAT: ImageSc axes now use data units with fixed colour ranges and readable ticks; FIX: ColorMap::valueToColor(v, "RedBlue") now spans the whole red-blue map instead of part of it.
Alongside: redrawn figures for five examples, clang-format on niceticks.h and regenerated API pages — improvements to figure trustworthiness.
For teams producing report figures or checking results with MNE-CPP, a truncated colour map misleads readers about value distributions.
items.brief: MNE-CPP 在 10 月 25 日推进 11 次提交，集中在绘图可信度：FEAT 让 **ImageSc 的坐标轴使用数据单位**、固定颜色范围并给出可读刻度；FIX 修正 `ColorMap::valueToColor(v, "RedBlue")` 只覆盖部分红蓝映射的问题——颜色映射被截断时，读者会误判数值分布（比如把中间值看成极值）。同批还有五个示例插图重绘、`niceticks.h` 的 clang-format 与 API 页面重生成。对用该框架产出报告图或做结果核对的团队，这类改动不影响算法，却直接影响「图是否忠实反映数据」；升级后建议抽查几张既有图与旧版对比。
items.brief_en: MNE-CPP made 11 commits on Oct 25 focused on figure trustworthiness: ImageSc axes now use data units with fixed colour ranges and readable ticks, and ColorMap::valueToColor(v, "RedBlue") now spans the whole red-blue map instead of part of it — a truncated map misleads readers about value distributions. Also redrawn example figures, clang-format and regenerated API pages.
items.raw_excerpt: Commits 2026-10-25: "FEAT: ImageSc axes in data units, fixed colour ranges and readable tic[ks]" (919f55f75e) 08:54Z; "FIX: ColorMap::valueToColor(v, \"RedBlue\") spans the whole red-blue map" 08:53Z; "DOC: figures for five more examples" 08:54Z; "STYLE: clang-format plots/detail/niceticks.h" 08:58Z.
items.why_valuable: 颜色映射截断会让读者误判数值分布，图表忠实度直接影响结论解读。
